summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K providing a first-quarter operational and financial update. The update notes a follow-on offering in May 2026 for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately €86.1 million, including pre-funded warrants, but does not specify price per share, terms, or use of proceeds. The offering is mentioned as part of a broader business update, not as a standalone event. The filing does not detail a board recommendation or advisor. No specific structural or regulatory timeline is provided. What to watch: any subsequent filings detailing terms or why the offering was structured with pre-funded warrants.
